# IIIF Cookbook snapshots

These fixtures are snapshots of the canonical IIIF Cookbook manifests used by the playback regression suite:

- `0004-canvas-size.json`: https://iiif.io/api/cookbook/recipe/0004-canvas-size/manifest.json
- `0013-placeholder-canvas.json`: https://iiif.io/api/cookbook/recipe/0013-placeholderCanvas/manifest.json
- `0017-transcription-av.json`: https://iiif.io/api/cookbook/recipe/0017-transcription-av/manifest.json
- `0026-toc-opera.json`: https://iiif.io/api/cookbook/recipe/0026-toc-opera/manifest.json

Refresh these snapshots periodically from those URLs. The automated tests intentionally use the local copies so CI does not depend on the live Cookbook service.
